mapper.sql: SELECT rcpt_id AS receipt_id,rcpt_dt,rcpt_amt,rmrk_desc FROM bill.rcpt WHERE bill_id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE bill.rcpt SET rcpt_dt=#{input.rcpt_dt},rcpt_amt=#{input.rcpt_amt},rmrk_desc=#{input.rmrk_desc} WHERE bill_id=#{id} AND rcpt_id=#{receiptId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM bill.rcpt WHERE bill_id=#{id} AND rcpt_id=#{receiptId}
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(sum(tot_amt),0) FROM bill.bill WHERE orgnl_bill_id=#{id} AND amnd_yn='Y' AND bill_stts_cd='CONFIRM'
SELECT COALESCE(sum(rcpt_amt),0) FROM bill.rcpt WHERE bill_id=#{id} AND rcpt_id != #{receiptId}
SELECT cls_stts_cd FROM fin.mth_cls WHERE cls_ym=#{month}
mapper.sql: SELECT json_build_object('bill_id',b.bill_id,'bill_stg_id',b.bill_stg_id,'virtual_plan',false, 'bill_no',b.bill_no,'prj_id',b.prj_id,'project_name',p.prj_nm,'customer_id',p.cust_ptnr_id, 'customer_name',c.ptnr_nm,'contract_type',p.cntrct_ty_cd,'atrb_ym',b.atrb_ym,'bill_dt',b.bill_dt, 'sply_amt',b.sply_amt,'vat_amt',b.vat_amt,'tot_amt',b.tot_amt,'bill_stts_cd',b.bill_stts_cd, 'txinv_no',b.txinv_no,'txinv_dt',b.txinv_dt,'rcpt_plan_dt',b.rcpt_plan_dt, 'received_amt',COALESCE(r.amount,0),'adjusted_total_amt',b.tot_amt+COALESCE(a.amount,0), 'receivable_amt',CASE WHEN b.bill_stts_cd='CONFIRM' THEN greatest(b.tot_amt+COALESCE(a.amount,0)-COALESCE(r.amount,0),0) ELSE 0 END, 'reminder_stage',CASE WHEN b.rcpt_plan_dt IS NULL OR b.bill_stts_cd!='CONFIRM' OR b.tot_amt+COALESCE(a.amount,0)-COALESCE(r.amount,0)<=0 THEN NULL WHEN (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date-b.rcpt_plan_dt >=60 THEN 3 WHEN (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date-b.rcpt_plan_dt >=30 THEN 2 WHEN (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date-b.rcpt_plan_dt >=7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::text FROM bill.bill b JOIN prj.prj p ON p.prj_id=b.prj_id LEFT JOIN mst.ptnr c ON c.ptnr_id=p.cust_ptnr_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT bill_id,sum(rcpt_amt) amount FROM bill.rcpt GROUP BY bill_id) r ON r.bill_id=b.bill_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT orgnl_bill_id,sum(tot_amt) amount FROM bill.bill WHERE amnd_yn='Y' AND bill_stts_cd='CONFIRM' GROUP BY orgnl_bill_id) a ON a.orgnl_bill_id=b.bill_id
mapper.select: SELECT json_build_object('asgn_id',d.asgn_id,'dev_id',a.dev_id,'cntrct_dev_id',d.cntrct_dev_id, 'display_name',n.dev_nm,'work_ym',d.work_ym,'mm_qty',d.mm_qty,'source_mm_qty',m.mm_qty, 'untprc_amt',d.untprc_amt,'work_day_qty',d.work_day_qty,'work_tm_qty',d.work_tm_qty, 'ovtm_tm_qty',d.ovtm_tm_qty,'ovtm_amt',d.ovtm_amt,'bill_amt',d.bill_amt,'rmrk_desc',d.rmrk_desc)::text FROM bill.bill_dtl d LEFT JOIN asgn.asgn a ON a.asgn_id=d.asgn_id LEFT JOIN mst.dev n ON n.dev_id=COALESCE(d.cntrct_dev_id,a.dev_id) LEFT JOIN asgn.asgn_mth m ON m.asgn_id=d.asgn_id AND m.work_ym=d.work_ym WHERE d.bill_id=#{id} ORDER BY d.bill_dtl_id

SELECT json_build_object('description',concat(h.data_chg_ty_cd,' ',h.bfr_val,' → ',h.aft_val), 'changed_at',h.chg_at,'user_id',h.chg_user_id::text)::text FROM sys.data_chg_hist h WHERE (h.tbl_nm='bill.bill' AND h.obj_rec_id=CAST(#{id} AS text)) OR (h.tbl_nm='bill.rcpt' AND h.rsn_desc=concat('청구 #',CAST(#{id} AS text),' 입금')) ORDER BY h.chg_at,h.data_chg_hist_id

SELECT '공급가액과 상세 합계가 다릅니다.' FROM bill.bill b WHERE b.bill_id=#{id} AND b.amnd_yn='N' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bill.bill_dtl d WHERE d.bill_id=b.bill_id) AND b.sply_amt != (SELECT sum(d.bill_amt) FROM bill.bill_dtl d WHERE d.bill_id=b.bill_id)
